title: Service Booking and Reminder Voice Agent
summary: A voice agent that calls customers when service is due, books workshop slots in the DMS, answers inbound booking calls and runs post-service follow-ups in Hindi, English and regional languages.

seo.title: Service Booking and Reminder Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: Voice agent for dealer workshops: due-service reminder calls, inbound booking, pick-up requests, WhatsApp confirmations and post-service follow-up.

designed_for: Customer Relations Manager at a dealership

problem.intro: Dealer workshops depend on customers returning for periodic maintenance, but reminder calls are made by a small customer relations team working through long due lists. Calls go unanswered, bookings are not entered into the DMS, and post-service follow-up is the first task dropped on a busy day.

pain_points.title: Due lists longer than the team
pain_points.detail: Customer relations executives cannot reach every vehicle due for service, so lapsed customers drift to independent garages.

pain_points.title: Bookings that never reach the DMS
pain_points.detail: Slots agreed on the phone are noted on paper or not at all, leading to overbooked mornings and no-shows.

pain_points.title: Language mismatch
pain_points.detail: Customers prefer Hindi, Hinglish or a regional language, and a single English script loses them.

pain_points.title: Follow-up calls skipped
pain_points.detail: Post-service follow-up is often missed, so dissatisfied customers complain to the OEM before the dealer hears about it.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that works from your DMS due list and your inbound service line. It filters numbers against consent and calling-window rules, calls in the customer's preferred language and introduces itself as an automated assistant. It offers available slots from the workshop calendar, records concerns such as noise, weak AC or warning lights as job card notes, offers pick-up and drop where you provide it, and quotes only approved menu prices for standard services. Bookings go straight into the DMS with a WhatsApp confirmation and a reminder the day before. After delivery, it runs follow-up calls and escalates any unhappy customer to the service manager.
capabilities: Outbound due-service reminders from DMS data, with slot booking
Inbound booking, rescheduling and cancellation on the service line
Captures customer concerns as job card notes for the service advisor
Quotes only approved menu prices for standard periodic services
Post-service follow-up calls with escalation of dissatisfied customers

workflow.title: Build the call list
workflow.detail: Vehicles due for service are pulled from the DMS and filtered for consent, DND preferences and permitted calling hours.

workflow.title: Call in the right language
workflow.detail: The agent calls in the customer's preferred language and states that it is an automated assistant.

workflow.title: Offer slots and capture concerns
workflow.detail: It offers available slots, records concerns and pick-up needs, and answers menu-price questions.

workflow.title: Hand over when needed
workflow.detail: Repair questions, estimates beyond the menu and complaints go to a service advisor with a call summary.

workflow.title: Book and confirm
workflow.detail: Bookings are written to the DMS calendar, followed by a WhatsApp confirmation and reminder.

workflow.title: Follow up after service
workflow.detail: A follow-up call after delivery captures satisfaction and escalates problems to the service manager.

inputs: Service due list from the DMS
Delivered job cards for follow-up calls
outputs: Bookings written to the DMS calendar
Customer concerns attached to upcoming job cards
human_in_the_loop: Service advisors take over for repair questions, estimates beyond the menu and complaints. Any dissatisfied follow-up response reaches the service manager the same day, and managers review a sample of calls each week.
integrations: OEM customer satisfaction or follow-up system
guardrails: Calls only within permitted hours and to customers with valid consent
Identifies itself as an automated assistant at the start of each call
No repair diagnosis and no prices beyond the approved menu
Customer can reach a person at any time
Recordings retained only for the period your policy sets

Customer data and recordings handled under the DPDP Act 2023.

faqs.q: Will customers know they are talking to an AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent says so at the start of every call and offers a person whenever the customer asks. Being upfront also keeps the conversation honest if something goes wrong.
Hindi, English and Hinglish as standard, plus regional languages for your market. We test on recordings of your customers before the pilot goes live.

faqs.q: Does it work with our DMS?
faqs.a: Yes, through the DMS appointment API or a staging integration agreed with your DMS provider. Bookings appear in the same calendar your advisors already use.

faqs.q: Is this compliant with TRAI rules?
faqs.a: The agent calls only within permitted hours, checks consent and DND preferences and uses registered headers and templates for messages. Your compliance team approves the scripts and calling rules before go-live.
